blocks.heading: A site you can click
blocks.body:
**WebHelp** is a draft website the engine builds from your booklet. Apply the recipe. Read **Transformation**. Open `index.html`.

You are not designing a theme today. You are proving the booklet produces a site you can click.

If the product name is still the key string, the root map or the recipe’s booklet input is wrong.

A local site is a draft on your desk. That is enough this week.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Draft site, three contents checks.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You published a single page and called it the book, or you cannot find index.html, or you saved the output into topics/.

Expected: A site folder exists. Three contents lines mapped to files. Product name resolved :  or a first error line parked for day 40.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Draft site, three contents checks.
blocks.intro: How to Draft site, three contents checks. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Draft site, three contents checks
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Apply the WebHelp Responsive recipe on kitepump.ditamap. Wait for the Transformation view.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: If the status is SUCCESS, open out-webhelp/index.html in a browser (Oxygen may offer Open).

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Write three table-of-contents labels you see and the page files they come from.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Confirm the product name resolved in the site (Kitepump KP-2a, not the key string).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: If the expert step is missing, check whether novice.ditaval was attached. Write which it was.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: If the status is FAILED, do not panic :  day 40 is the failed-log lab. Still paste the first error line into the field note and stop; do not thrash for an hour.

blocks.q: A WebHelp output is a folder. What is the usual file you open first?
blocks.why: You open HTML. The map is source.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: The site’s table of contents is missing a page that completeness still includes. First place you look?
options: toc="no" on the booklet line, or a nested booklet not pointed at
blocks.why: Publish reads the booklet. toc=no hides a node. Completeness does not mean ‘visible in the site contents’.
